svg.title: A keyword scan against a model classifier, on the crisis path
svg.desc: A model classifier catches phrasings nobody wrote down and handles paraphrase and typos, but it can be argued out of its judgement by the message it is reading, it fails open when the provider is down, and you cannot enumerate what it will do. A keyword scan misses anything not on the list and trips on negations, but it cannot be talked out of anything, cannot fail open, and the entire behaviour can be printed on one page and reviewed by a clinician. On the path where being wrong causes harm, reviewability wins.
svg.text: Better at the job, in every ordinary sense
− can be argued out of its judgement by the text it is reading
− fails open when the provider is down
− nobody can enumerate what it will do
Worse at the job, and chosen anyway
− misses anything not on the list
+ cannot be talked out of anything
+ cannot fail open — there is nothing to fail
+ prints on one page, and a clinician can sign it off
On the path where being wrong sends someone to bed instead of to hospital,
a mechanism you can review beats a mechanism that scores better.
